dataset_spec.name: physionet_2019
dataset_spec.description: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019 ICU set A (first 1000 patients). Binary ever-sepsis from an early-stay vital and laboratory snapshot.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult admitted to an intensive care unit (PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019, training set A, one hospital system). The observations are age, sex, ICU unit type, the time from hospital admission to ICU admission, and the most recent value of each vital sign and laboratory test within the first six hours in the ICU; tests not yet performed are marked as not observed.
dataset_spec.observations_header: First six hours in the ICU (most recent value per variable):
